descriptionChirho: A scroll or written roll of parchment or papyrus, used for recording prophetic oracles, divine laws, or other written documents. Prominent in Jeremiah 36 (Baruch's scroll) and Ezekiel 2-3 (the scroll eaten by the prophet). The two clusters differ only in grammatical state — absolute/determined 'the scroll' (eng: the scroll / scroll, spa: el rollo, hin: पुस्तक, arb: الدَّرْجِ, kor: 두루마리를, swa: gombo) versus construct 'scroll of' (eng: scroll of, spa: rollo de, hin: पुस्तक, arb: دَرْجِ, swa: gombo la).
